{{Top|leg}} {{City |image= |name=Bralsin |constructed= |destroyed= |rebuilt= |builder=[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'' |mayor= |celestialbody=[[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] |continent= |location=Near the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]]''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' |climate=Temperate |interest=[[Fenn Shysa's memorial]] |population= |demonym= |affiliation=Mandalorians }} {{Quote|It's a spot with its own history.|[[Goran Beviin]]|}} '''Bralsin''' was a small [[City/Legends|settlement]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Located near the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], Bralsin sat atop a hill at the edge of the broad and shallow [[Kelita valley]], filled with [[Farm/Legends|farmland]], [[Tree/Legends|woods]], and a number of homesteads. It was the location of the [[Fenn Shysa's memorial|memorial]] for the one-time [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Fenn Shysa]], and had been one of many battlefields where the Mandalorians clashed with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] on Mandalore in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. ==Description== {{Quote|Sacred site? I can feel something happened here, a battle maybe.''"
"''''Vongese''. But no prizes for guessing that.|Jaina Solo and Goran Beviin|}} Bralsin was a small [[City/Legends|settlement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], located so near to Mandalore's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], that [[MandalMotors tower|the tower]] of the [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] company could be seen from Bralsin's higher reaches. Situated atop a sloping hill at the edge of the broad and shallow [[Kelita valley]], Bralsin overlooked a mass of cultivated [[Farm/Legends|farmland]], [[Tree/Legends|woods]], and a number of fortified homesteads. The land around it was speckled with trees and bushes, and it's most notable feature was perhaps the [[Fenn Shysa's memorial|memorial for Fenn Shysa]], a [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] who had been beloved by his people. [[Skeleton/Legends|Skulls]] and [[Bone/Legends|bones]] of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] were often found around Bralsin, left over from the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. ==History== {{Quote|I think there were a few thousand of them. And this was a poor place to defend, but we took them on. You fought the ''vongese'', didn't you? You understand.|Goran Beviin|}} The small settlement of Bralsin was chosen by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to be the location of a memorial to the dead former ''Mand'alor'', [[Fenn Shysa]]. There, on the top of a hill and in a clearing surrounded by a small number of [[Tree/Legends|trees]], Fett laid Shysa's green and red-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] atop an unmarked column of [[Granite/Legends|granite]], securing it with a peg against the weather. Close to twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] would pass before Fett again visited the site. Bralsin was a battlefield during the Yuuzhan Vong War, and it was on Bralsin's soft hills that the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] battled several thousand Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]] during their [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] on Mandalore. The [[Blood/Legends|bloodshed]] was so great that even decades later, skulls of dead Yuuzhan Vong would turn up littered across the landscape when it rained. In [[41 ABY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] journeyed to Mandalore to seek Boba Fett's training and aid in stopping her brother, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]—by then a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] calling himself Darth Caedus. Fett would agree to help train Solo, but Fett's friend [[Goran Beviin]] would oftentimes take over training duties. In doing so, he brought Solo to Bralsin, near the memorial to Fenn Shysa. There, the two paid their respects, and Beviin instructed Solo in the use of a Mandalorian ''[[Beskad/Legends|beskad]]'' [[Sword/Legends|saber]]. Over the [[Time/Legends|time]] of Solo's Mandalore training, Bralsin became a meeting place between her and Fett and her and Beviin. When Solo arranged a meeting between herself and the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-Mandalorian, [[Bardan Jusik|Gotab]], it was at Bralsin that they met and after a philosophical discussion between the two, Bralsin became the backdrop for a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] between Solo and Gotab's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] nephew, [[Venku Skirata]]. ==Behind the scenes== Bralsin was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the eighth novel of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series. Entitled [[Legacy of the Force: Revelation|''Revelation'']], the novel was [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[February 26]], [[2008]]. ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' also gave Bralsin a brief entry within its pages. Bralsin's name is drawn from the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] word ''bral'', meaning "hill fort, high ground, or high defended position".{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/html/mando.htm|text=Ke jorhaa'ir Mando'a!|author=Karen Traviss|archivedate=20090923140534}} ==Appearances== *''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'' {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |pl=Bralsin }} [[Category:Mandalore locations]] [[Category:Settlements]]
